environment.description: Same Node.js application deployed on ECS Fargate behind ALB. The task execution role (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/EcsTaskRole) has an attached IAM permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/PB-RestrictDestructiveOps) that contains an explicit Deny on dynamodb:DeleteItem and dynamodb:UpdateItem actions when the condition key aws:RequestedRegion matches the deployment region AND the resource ARN matches arn:aws:dynamodb:*:*:table/Users. The SCP at the OU level (scp-0a1b2c3d4e) additionally denies iam:CreateRole and sts:AssumeRole for any principal within this account except the deployment pipeline role. Note: the ALB operates in HTTP mode but does NOT have AWS WAF attached; the ALB's HTTP parser may normalize some headers but does not specifically block smuggling variants using line-folding or multiple Transfer-Encoding values with obfuscation (e.g., 'Transfer-Encoding: chunked, identity').

config.load_balancer: ALB in HTTP mode (no WAF attached)
config.alb_note: ALB HTTP parser active but no WAF rule groups attached
